title: Service Operations Platform
summary: Job requests, assignments, approvals, and records in one internal system.
details: A concept for a facilities services company. Staff log requests, assign jobs, and track approvals; managers see every job in one place.
challenge: Requests arrive by phone, email, and chat. Assignments live in spreadsheets, approvals in email threads, and no one sees the full picture.
solution: One job record moving through clear stages, with assignments, approvals, and history. Staff work from an open-jobs board with filters.

title: Clinic Booking System
summary: Online appointments, staff schedules, and patient reminders in one place.
details: A concept for a small multi-practitioner clinic. Patients book online, staff manage one calendar, and the front desk sees every appointment.
challenge: Appointments are booked by call and message, then written in a logbook. Double bookings happen and the front desk spends the day coordinating.
solution: Online booking tied to real availability, a shared front-desk calendar, and visit reminders. Rescheduling updates the calendar immediately.

title: Inventory and Sales Tracker
summary: Stock levels, product movement, and daily sales tracking in one system.
details: A concept for a growing retailer. Every product has one record, stock updates as sales and deliveries are logged, and low stock is flagged early.
challenge: Stock is counted by hand into spreadsheets that rarely match. Items run out unnoticed, and month-end reconciliation takes a weekend.
solution: One catalog where every delivery, sale, and adjustment is recorded. Stock stays current, and items below reorder point appear on a daily list.

title: Customer Relationship Management
summary: Manage customers, interactions, and sales opportunities efficiently.
details: A concept for a specialty retailer. Staff look up customers at the counter, see past purchases, and schedule follow-ups so none are forgotten.
challenge: Customer details live in notebooks and personal phones. When staff are away, follow-ups are missed and customers repeat themselves.
solution: One profile per customer with history and every interaction. Follow-ups are assigned, with a pipeline view of open inquiries.

title: Operations Dashboard
summary: Key business figures and team activity at a single, modern dashboard.
details: A concept for a delivery business. Managers check daily figures, filter by date or team, and spot trends without exporting spreadsheets.
challenge: Daily figures are compiled by hand and shared the next morning, so problems are noticed a day late.
solution: A dashboard with summary figures, trends, and breakdowns by team and status, with filters and role-based access.

title: Coworking Space Website
summary: A fast, mobile-first website with membership plans and tour bookings.
details: A concept for an independent coworking space. Visitors compare plans, see the space, and book a tour on a fast, phone-friendly site.
challenge: The space is promoted only through social posts. Prospects cannot compare plans or book visits, so inquiries arrive as scattered messages.
solution: A clear website with plan comparisons, a photo-led tour, and a booking form. The team updates content without a developer.
